population_identity_accounting.identity: groupUID + original prompt/response ID SHA, preserving multiplicity

strict_R_coverage_and_intersection.definition: Token mask R = exact repetition union noisy strict0.75, with the frozen EOS/whitespace/unstable-byte exclusions. This is distinct from response-level normalized-text cycle128.
strict_R_coverage_and_intersection.anchor_definition: s0 = logp(round start) - logq(saved rollout); negative anchor anomaly is A<0 ands0<-0.5. A sign is not a correctness label.
strict_R_coverage_and_intersection.current_d_scope: d = abs(logp(current update)-logq(saved rollout)); all valid positions including masked tokens, not active-loss-only.

measurement_scope: Candidates: all newly completed training rollout groups601..650 including rejected all-correct/all-wrong; q only, no actorp/d/A gradient observations for untrained candidates.
Accepted: actual512 responses per round, partitioned by saved A sign; tokens and statistics include masked and zero-A positions unless explicitly a direct-coefficient field.
Correctness acc and advantage sign are distinct. A is the actual group-relative training advantage; correctness alone does not reconstruct it.
NLL(q)=-logq and logPPL=token-pooled meanNLL. d=abs(logp-logq) is a separate mismatch metric; neither replaces the other.
Direct dL/dlogp coefficient mass/L2 is not a positive/negative parameter-gradient norm or causal gradient decomposition. Whole-parameter norm is measured once per actual optimizer update.
Primary: repeated64-question8-response native evaluations; no fixed per-question/replicate request seeds, and no q/p/d or advantage-sign statistics are claimed here.
Cycle128, strictR exact-or-noisy token masks and garble candidates are different nonexclusive mechanical detectors; absence of one is not a semantic normality verdict.
Sixth cached24984 rows are reuse and miss31664 rows were processed once by the original BBB pool; closing verifies sources/row fields/q/age without redetection.
Strict R coverage/intersection comes from the already verified actual sixth native accepted-token scope, not a fifth-arm mask field or a semantic repetition verdict.

First five methods retain the published comparison fields. Sixth candidate row statistics are adopted as a declared BBB native-source reporting supplement; no canonical-table, archive or secondary acceptance is promoted.
